snippet.title: Kalien Hero Trailer - DragonSword : Awakening
snippet.description:
"Do you wish to live? Kneel."

A Spiritist who fights alongside Sur, a fox spirit imbued with the power of fire — Kalien.

She is traveling across the Continent of Orbis with Dana to find Dana's mother.

Witness her powerful flame magic, Stun Status Ailments, and spectacular explosive fire combat for yourself.

"DragonSword : Awakening" is set to officially launch on Steam this July.

Follow our channels to stay up to date with the latest news.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4570720/
Discord: https://discord.gg/CzZ5ddkMVg
X : https://x.com/DSAwakening
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@DragonSwordAwakening
